primary_goal: inelastic/resonance A_PV; coupling optimization is secondary
scenario_interpretation: Controlled changes of explicitly unknown inputs, not calibrated uncertainty or a probability band.

references.use: A pure isospin-3/2 vector transition has gamma-Z/electromagnetic ratio 2-4*sin2thetaW; used only as a component-limit diagnostic, not the full inclusive response.
Electromagnetic resonance cross sections alone do not specify the full weak resonance response; helicity amplitudes and resonance/background decomposition matter.
